sections.heading: D — Accuracy and Verification
sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and Verification, Section Eight Signals and markings

Section D records the accuracy posture for the Section Eight Signals and markings dossier. Every knowledge fact is required to trace to its cited physical handbook page, with the cited page stating the fact. Confidence is high across the section because every rule comes from the single pinned handbook edition, and every number is spelled out in words so that the card backs read aloud exactly. The extracted text of these pages carries a font-encoding shift that garbles scattered words into offset letters and turns commas into line breaks, and the signal and lane-control captions interleave with figure labels; the dossier author decoded the shift deterministically, matched each caption to its indication by the surrounding text, and describes every signal and marking by color, shape and line pattern so that no statement depends on a figure the learner cannot see. Handbook wording is paraphrased throughout; no official sentence, table, image or question is reproduced. No time-variable or location-variable fact appears beyond the pinned edition, so nothing required isolation as dynamic knowledge.

corpus_stability.reason: The West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so the Section Eight Signals and markings content changes at most with a new edition.
